title: werauhia ororiensis
intro: Werauhia ororiensis, commonly known as the Red Hairy Palm, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Werauhia ororiensis include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
